description: Update an existing blog publication's metadata — title, description, domain/routing config, layout, public URL settings (siteBaseUrl, articlePattern like '/blog/{category}/{slug}/', categoryPattern, uncategorizedSegment, trailingSlash toggle; hostingMode 'external' for headless sites that serve content themselves), CTA configuration, or the publication's default author (defaultAuthorId). Only the fields you pass are changed (partial update). Distinct from create_publication (which creates a new one). publicationId comes from list_publications or list_blogs.

articlePattern.description: Article path pattern; tokens {slug} (required), {category}, {lang}. E.g. '/blog/{category}/{slug}/'. Trailing slash follows the pattern. Default '{pathPrefix}/{slug}'. null clears.

brandId.description: Brand ID (uses active brand if omitted)

categoryPattern.description: Category hub path pattern with {category}, e.g. '/blog/{category}/'. Must not be able to match the same URL as articlePattern. Default derived from articlePattern. null clears.

description.description: What this destination is/does and who it's for — this is the text the CTA generator's relevance pick matches against.

enabled.description: Disabled entries are kept for later but never picked by the generator.

id.description: Client-generatable stable id (cuid2-ish) — keep the same id across edits/reorders of an existing destination; make up a new one for a new destination.

label.description: Short human name, e.g. "Book a demo" — also the target name the CTA generator's copy is written around.

tier.description: How hard to push this destination. "primary" is the money link and owns the end-anchored CTA; "secondary" is preferred for in-article section CTAs; "tertiary" is used sparingly, as the last resort on both selection ladders.

url.description: Absolute http(s) URL, or a site-relative path starting with "/". Protocol-relative ("//host") and non-http schemes are rejected.

ctaDestinations.description: Full-replace ordered list (max 24) of hand-curated CTA link destinations the generator rotates through — for publications whose real conversion pages aren't PostKing side pages (e.g. externally-hosted/synced blogs). Pass null or [] to clear the pool, which puts the publication back on automatic side-page matching.

anyOf.description: Any omitted sub-field keeps its current/default value — this is a merge, not a full replace, of the settings object itself.

autoGenerate.description: Whether persist-time auto-CTA-generation runs at all.

defaultCtaCount.description: 0-6. How many CTAs to auto-generate per article at persist time.

sectionCtaStyle.description: Visual style stamped onto generated after_h2 section CTAs. The end-anchored CTA (when one is generated) is always "strong" regardless of this setting. Server default "light".

ctaSettings.description: Publication-level defaults for auto-generated CTAs (how many per article, whether auto-generation runs at all, and the visual style of in-article section CTAs). Pass null to reset to the server defaults (defaultCtaCount: 1, autoGenerate: true, sectionCtaStyle: "light").

defaultAuthorId.description: Default author for new articles in this publication (from list_blog_authors; active author of the brand). null clears it back to the brand default. Same as set_default_blog_author with publicationId.

domainId.description: Custom domain ID to route this publication under

hostingMode.description: 'postking' (default, PostKing serves the blog), 'self_hosted' (you render it with your own app against the public /api/blog-posts?blogId=<publicationId> API) or 'external' (your own site serves it; PostKing only emits URLs, no domain may be connected). Must match the connected domain's hostingMode, else 409 hosting_mode_mismatch. See set_publication_hosting_mode.

publicationId.description: Blog publication ID (from list_publications or list_blogs)

redirectLegacyBlogPath.description: Only meaningful when this publication is on "subdomain" routing: when true, requests to the old <apex-domain>/blog/* path redirect to the new blog.<apex-domain>/* location instead of 404ing. Ignored for path/root routing.

siteBaseUrl.description: https origin (optional path) the publication's public URLs are built on, e.g. https://linkmatch.com. Overrides the connected-domain base and is honoured with no domain for hostingMode 'external'. null clears.

trailingSlash.description: Convenience toggle: true makes article and category URLs end with "/", false removes it (default off, slashless). Rewrites the stored articlePattern (and categoryPattern when set); with no articlePattern, true materializes '{pathPrefix}/{slug}/'. Combine with articlePattern to set both at once.

uncategorizedSegment.description: Path segment substituted for {category} on articles with no category. Default 'uncategorized'. null clears.

name: update_publication
